items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Then there was Jack Lycan who played left hand trombone.

ctx.x: He died. No, I think he's in a mental hospital now. One of them is.
Then there was Jack Lycan who played left hand trombone.
I didn't know. It was Joe who still plays bass and Arnold is still around. They're the only ones I've met.
